title: Neko mission line
description: One large soft-serif statement set in the right half of the page (full width on phones), with an arrow link under it, below a band that fades from the lemon wash to white. As it scrolls in, its words light up one after another from 30% to full strength.
notes: the fade band at the top runs from highlight to background, to follow a highlight section (turn it off with fadeFrom="none")
CSS scroll-driven; without support or with reduced motion the words are simply at full strength
